note: Three flights, three windows. DAILY = period_interval 1440 over the full stored history. HOURLY = period_interval 60 over the curated intraday store (which since 2026-09-18 includes the settled KXHIGHNY weather brackets with real exchange results). MICRO = period_interval 1 over the 1-minute store (the KXGOLD15M 15-minute gold markets). They are reported separately and are never merged into one ranking, because a strategy that needs intraday bars cannot be judged on daily ones.
